name: Brain Bazaar
tagline: Bet on what you know. Bold bets pay double, bad ones sting.

missions.title: Estimate It
missions.brief: Guess the number and stake coins on it. The closer you are, the bigger the payout. Way off and you lose the stake.

missions.title: Fact or Fib
missions.brief: Four statements, one is a fib. Pick it and bet on your nose for nonsense. Right pays, wrong costs.

missions.title: Chain Reaction
missions.brief: One link in a chain of ideas is missing. Reason out the link, then back your answer with coins.
